title: Talentless Nana Manga to End in 2 More Chapters
content: The June issue of Square Enix 's Monthly Shonen Gangan magazine reported on Tuesday that Looseboy and Iori Furuya 's Talentless Nana ( Munō na Nana ) manga will end in two more chapters. If there are no delays, the manga will end in July. Square Enix 's Manga UP!
author: ANN

title: Takashi Tezuka to Retires From Nintendo in June
content: Nintendo announced on Friday that executive officer Takashi Tezuka will retire on June 26. Tezuka began his career at Nintendo in 1984, working side-by-side with Shigeru Miyamoto on the Mario series since Super Mario Bros. and then on The Legend of Zelda series since the first game.
author: ANN

title: Ultraman Franchise Gets 60th Anniversary Documentary Film on July 3
content: Tsuburaya Productions announced on April 20 that its Ultraman tokusatsu franchise will have a documentary film titled The Origin of Ultraman . The documentary's website began streaming a trailer on Thursday, revealing its July 3 opening date.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Zelda Film to Open 1 Week Sooner on April 30, 2027
content: The Legend of Zelda game co-creator Shigeru Miyamoto announced on Wednesday that the franchise 's live-action film's opening date is now set for April 30, 2027, a week earlier from its previously planned May 7, 2027 opening date.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Manga Adds 23 Kodansha USA Catalog Titles, Dricam!! From Shueisha
content: Crunchyroll announced on Wednesday it is partnering with Kodansha USA to add manga titles from Kodansha 's back catalog to the Crunchyroll Manga app on May 18. Crunchyroll will also add You Chiba's Dricam!! from Shueisha to the app on the same date.
author: ANN

title: Will Ascends the Tower in Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 2 Episode 6 Preview, New Trailer Revealed
content: Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 2 has revealed the preview images and synopsis for Episode 6 (Episode 18 overall) alongside a new trailer. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime worldwide, with Episode 6 scheduled to premiere on May 17.
author: Anime Corner

title: Witch Hat Atelier Anime Reveals Second Story Visual Featuring Scenes From Episode 6
content: Witch Hat Atelier revealed a new story visual following the release of Episode 6 in Japan. Studio BUG FILMS ( Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead ) is in charge of the animation, with Crunchyroll streaming the anime globally. The anime has been the best-voted non-sequel every week of Spring 2026 so far .
author: Anime Corner

title: Live-Action Blue Lock Film Reveals More Cast, New Key Visual
content: The staff for the live-action film based on Muneyuki Kaneshiro and Yūsuke Nomura 's BLUE LOCK soccer manga announced more cast members this past week, along with a key visual of 20 cast members on Wednesday.
author: ANN
